_comment: Cheap variation on an-empty-killer-name-lifesaved-engulfed-over-lava: teleport.c level_tele() (1321) clears the killer name instead of a nested done(), so no 'Die?' answer is involved. A debug-mode gnomish Archeologist reaches experience level 8, puts on a blessed amulet of life saving, steps off the stairs, lets a hostile purple worm swallow him, and wishes a level teleporter under himself. The worm digests him: mhitu.c done_in_by() names the worm with KILLED_BY_AN, end.c done() uses up the amulet, savelife() expels him onto the trap, and level_tele() clears svk.killer.name on the way to its destination. The outer done() then calls topten.c formatkiller(), whose KILLED_BY_AN branch calls objnam.c an("") and its pline.c impossible() report. The seed, clock, character, engulfer and inputs were chosen for this path.
